1. (Currently amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, __wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

2. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about __5__-35 weight percent of the total composition.

3. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, __and is not mixed into said composition,__ and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.

4. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, __said extrusion aid being selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof__.

5. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof.

6. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate __and said desiccant is zeolite__.

7. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and said desiccant is zeolite__.

8. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, __and said desiccant is zeolite__.

14. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and said desiccant is zeolite__.

15. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate __and said desiccant is zeolite__.

16. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.

17. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __said desiccant being zeolite__.
